American Horror Story Season 13 Finale: All That Buildup for This?

video // Nov 3, 2026 · Updated Nov 6, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Full spoilers for the American Horror Story Season 13 finale.

The witches returned. The threat changed. And the ending wrapped things up faster than I expected. After a season of buildup, did the payoff feel big enough?

The villain stepping away

My main issue is the difference between a villain abandoning his immediate plan and the heroes overcoming it. A change of heart can work, but I wanted the episode to spend more time making that turn feel earned. When the conflict changes so quickly, the urgency changes with it.

A reunion that needed more struggle

Seeing the characters together was part of the appeal. I wanted that reunion to lead to a solution that needed their combined effort, with more resistance along the way. The review looks at why the speed of the resolution made some of the season’s biggest moments feel smaller to me.

Ben gets a choice

Ben does get a choice scene. My criticism is how quickly everyone accepts the proposed answer. His family and future give that decision weight; I wanted the plan itself to be tested more. That is a question about how the ending lands, rather than a claim that his decision never happens.
